sources.title: Pokémon TCG: Platinum—Arceus Official Card-Dex
sources.verification: Toxicroak's Corner states that the Defending Pokémon cannot retreat during the opponent's next turn.
sources.supportsZh: 用于可组合 prevent_retreat 的“指定公开宝可梦、至来源玩家下回合开始前不能普通撤退”基础持续效果。

sources.title: Pokémon TCG Errata — Skuntank (Diamond & Pearl—Stormfront)
sources.verification: Skuntank's erratum says that a selected Defending Pokémon's attack does nothing during the opponent's next turn and that the effect ends if it is no longer Active.
sources.supportsZh: 用于 prevent_attack 的攻击前服务器拒绝与“换到备战区即清除攻击效果”边界；不据此猜测任何未审核整卡的其它文字或时序。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, community discussion, Japanese local ruling or Chinese translation is used as an international rules authority.
The cited cards are historical modeling examples; this record does not certify their complete text, format legality or any current Standard status.
implementationLimits: prevent_attack and prevent_retreat accept one server-verified public in-play Pokémon and have no free-form duration argument; they expire at the source controller's next turn start through the shared continuous-effect lifecycle.

Both operations recheck card-effect protection on the target before writing the lock. Normal retreat and attack availability are enforced by the authoritative battlefield, while forced switching remains separate from prevent_retreat.

The components are available to reviewed resumable trainer, activated Ability, attack and automatic triggered-source programs. Automatic resolution uses the current turn only for server execution authority; duration is bound separately to the printed source controller.
Named-attack-only locks, coin-gated cancellation, alternate durations, multi-target distributions, replacement effects and unaudited real-card bindings remain unsupported.
